Please note that this is a holiday homes contract, and we have already shared the booking confirmation with you above.

The only pending document for signature is the check-in form, which has also been sent to you.

Additionally, we have arranged a representative who has meet you in person for the viewing/check-in and assist you throughout your entire stay. This is the standard holiday homes process.

He may also pass by our office for the payment , however, the contract remains the same as the booking confirmation we have already shared with you.
